title: Unforced
summary: UNFORCED, adjective 1. Not forced; not compelled; not constrained. 2. Not urged or impelled. 3. Not feigned; not heightened; natural as unforced passions; unforced expressions of joy. 4. Not violent;

inlines.v: UNFORCED, adjective 1. Not forced; not compelled; not constrained. 2. Not urged or impelled. 3. Not feigned; not heightened; natural as unforced passions; unforced expressions of joy. 4. Not violent; easy; gradual; as an easy and unforced ascent. 5. Easy; natural; as an unforced posture.
